task_commit_basis: merge commit of the reference change (code after the optimization landed), from https://github.com/rails/rails/commit/c23b2a4468a45f0a11820e3ad8597ac1e3ac19eb

workload.command: docker run --rm --init --stop-timeout 10 --name perfproof-rails-rails-pr58751-landed-workload -e BUNDLE_WITHOUT=rubocop:mdl:doc:job:cable:storage -v .:/src -v perfproof-gems:/usr/local/bundle -w /src/activesupport perfproof-ruby-4.0-tzdata-legacy bundle exec ruby --yjit -Ilib -e "require 'active_support'; require 'active_support/time'; t = Time.utc(2026, 1, 1).in_time_zone('Eastern Time (US & Canada)'); 300_000.times { t.xmlschema; t.to_s; ActiveSupport::TimeZone.seconds_to_utc_offset(-18000) }"
workload.source: adapted from the benchmark-ips script in the description of https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/58751 (TimeWithZone#xmlschema and #to_s on a non-UTC zone, and TimeZone.seconds_to_utc_offset, under YJIT)

oracle.command: docker run --rm --init --stop-timeout 10 --name perfproof-rails-rails-pr58751-landed-oracle -e BUNDLE_WITHOUT=rubocop:mdl:doc:job:cable:storage -v .:/src -v perfproof-gems:/usr/local/bundle -w /src/activesupport perfproof-ruby-4.0-tzdata-legacy bundle exec ruby -Itest -e "require './test/core_ext/time_with_zone_test'; require './test/time_zone_test'"
oracle.source: Active Support's TimeWithZone and TimeZone tests (both changed by https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/58751); targeted tests only

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: speedup claims: 3.10x; 2.70x; 1.20x; 1.78x; 1.96x | timings: 100ms; 654.61 ns; 5.065034s; 210.99 ns; 5.061557s; 704.20 ns; 5.028475s; 260.33 ns

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Ruby is not installed here, so it runs under Docker (a linux/arm64 VM on this Mac) in the official ruby:4.0 image plus tzdata-legacy (eval/tasks/workloads/_images/ruby-4.0-tzdata-legacy/Dockerfile): Debian trixie keeps the legacy US/* zone names Active Support's tests use in that package. Gems are the tree's Gemfile.lock (bundler 4.0.12), without the rubocop, mdl, doc, job, cable and storage groups
